description.ja: メカコレクションに「宇宙戦艦ヤマト2202」に登場！
description.en: "Space Battleship Yamato 2202" appears in the mecha collection!

description.ja: • 手のひらサイズながら、ヤマト2202のディテールを精密に再現！
description.en: • Details of Yamato 2202 are precisely reproduced in a palm-sized model!

description.ja: 艦橋やパルスレーザー砲を忠実に再現。
description.en: Faithfully reproduces the bridge and pulse laser cannon.

description.ja: • ポールジョイントで角度調整が可能な台座が付属。飛行シーンの再現も可能。
description.en: • A pedestal whose angle can be adjusted with a pole joint is included. It is also possible to reproduce flight scenes.

description.ja: • 船体側面から展開される「安定翼」を選択式で再現可能。
description.en: • The "stability wings" deployed from the side of the hull can be selectively reproduced.
